newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Banco Totta slides on rating review.
newsitem.headline: Banco Totta slides on rating review.

text.p: Shares in Banco Totta & Acores (BTA) and Banco Sotto & Pinto Mayor slumped nearly seven percent after Standard and Poor's cut its long-term outlook for BTA to negative from stable, traders said.

"There is some clear profit-taking on Totta and while the market remains negative, this is going to continue, even if it seems to me the stock has already suffered the main impact (of the news)," said one trader.
Banco Totta was down 229 escudos at 3,221, slightly above an earlier low of 3,200 escudos. The PSI .PSI20 index of leading shares was down 1.89 percent.
S&P reaffirmed its rating for BTA but the long term outlook was cut to negative.
The rating agency said that the group had strong potential but was vulnerable to any economic downturn because of its high leveraging.
"If this outlook had appeared when the market was on the rise, it might have been ignored but as a correction was already underway...the effects were amplified," said another trader.
